test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Tropic of cancer passes through which of the following state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Tropic of Cancer** is an imaginary line of latitude located at approximately **23°30′ N** of the **Equator**.
 
• In **India**, the **Tropic of Cancer** passes through a total of **eight states**. Moving from **West to East**, these states are **Gujarat**, **Rajasthan**, **Madhya Pradesh**, **Chhattisgarh**, **Jharkhand**, **West Bengal**, **Tripura**, and **Mizoram**.
 
• The line divides the Indian subcontinent into almost **two equal parts**, significantly influencing the **climatic patterns** by separating the **tropical zone** in the south from the **sub-tropical zone** in the north.
 
• Among the given options, **Mizoram** is the only state situated on this latitude; specifically, the line passes through the **southern part** of the state near the capital, **Aizawl**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geographical Exclusions**:

 
 
• **Maharashtra**, **Andhra Pradesh**, and **Goa** are all located entirely to the **south** of the **Tropic of Cancer** and thus do not intersect with it.
 
• States like **Odisha**, **Bihar**, and **Uttar Pradesh** are also frequently confused in exams but do not lie on the **23.5° N** latitude.
 
 
 
• **Key Geographical Facts**:
 
 
• The **Mahi River** is the only river in **India** that crosses the **Tropic of Cancer** twice, once in **Madhya Pradesh** and again in **Gujarat**.
 
• The city of **Udaipur** in **Tripura** is considered one of the closest cities to the **Tropic of Cancer**.
 
• **Ranchi**, the capital of **Jharkhand**, is the **state capital** located closest to this imaginary line.
